records.notes: Visible forms differ beyond marks: Hafs/Warsh/Qalun show إِنَّكُمۡ, Shu'bah shows أَءِنَّكُمۡ, and the other forms show أَ۟نَّكُمُۥ or أَٰ۟نَّكُمۡ.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰمَنَ while the other editions show ءَامَنَ, an initial alif/hamza presentation difference.
Visible forms show نَّبِيٍّ in most editions and نَّبِےٓءٍ in Warsh/Qalun, a clear lexical/letter-form difference.
The visible lexical form إسراءيل is consistent; Warsh/Qalun differ in dagger-alif and stopping-mark presentation from the other editions.
Visible forms show إِنَّ in Hafs/Warsh/Qalun/Bazzi/Qunbul, أَءِنَّ in Shu'bah, and أَٰ۟نَّ in Duri/Susi.
